text.title: Health cover as HR enrolled it against cover as the insurer holds it
text.lede: Here the thing being reconciled is a period of time. Each employee has two bars on one calendar: the cover HR recorded on top, the cover the insurer holds underneath. Where both agree there is a single grey bar. A blue or orange end sticking out is a stretch of time only one side covers.
text.chartSub: Plan year January to December. Dates must agree to the day. Select an employee.

records.name: Carla Voss
records.reason: Hired 1 March. The insurer started cover on 1 April, leaving her uninsured for March.

records.name: Deshawn Price
records.reason: Left on 31 May. The termination never reached the insurer, which is still charging premium.

records.name: Elif Kaya
records.reason: Changed to family cover after a birth in January. The insurer still holds the single plan, so dependants are not covered.

records.name: Hugo Meyer
records.reason: Leaves on 31 August. The insurer ends cover at the end of the following month, by its own rule.

records.name: Imani Brooks
records.reason: Enrolled by HR on 17 March. The insurer has no record: the enrolment file for that week was rejected.

records.name: Jon Petrov
records.reason: The insurer holds two member records for him, under two spellings of his surname. Premium is billed on both.

records.name: Dale Whitcomb
records.reason: Left in December 2025. The insurer renewed him for 2026 anyway.
